entries.name: rendered-form-action-drops-url-scope
entries.claim: The POST action rendered for a scoped create retains the legal-entity operand selected in the URL, so submitting the form cannot silently drop the scope the operator chose.

test.namePattern: scoped create carries each URL operand

kills.name: scoped create carries each URL operand under its declared system-input key
kills.expected: rendered POST action must retain the selected operand

entries.name: web-handoff-hardcodes-one-legal-entity
entries.claim: The web handoff carries the legal-entity operand read from the request rather than a fixed identifier, so a second URL value moves the effective operand.
